full_judgment: 20. In view of the legal position as discussed above, the allegation made in the plaint and the allegations made in the application for addition of parties we do not find that the said opposite parties arc necessary parties in this suit. The issue involved in the suit is whether the plaintiff has title to the suit property or whether the suit property is the Khas property of Bhawal Raj Court of Wards Estate and to adjudicate the issue presence of the opposite parties in not necessary. A court has jurisdiction to add as defendant a person even when a plaintiff does not wish to sue him only in a case where the plaintiff is seeking a relief which may directly affect the intervener by curtailing the enjoyment of his legal rights and consequently his presence is "necessary to enable the court to adjudicate completely and effectually upon and settle all the questions involved in the suit."
